Hi Alex,

Thanks again for taking the time earlier — great conversation. Quick recap from my side and a next-step proposal:  \

What I heard:
- Primary goal: reduce per-inquiry latency for customer support responses and cut inference cost at peak hours.
- Key constraints: PII redaction needs, VPC/network restrictions, needs SOC2 evidence and a procurement SOW.
- Success metric: 30% reduction in average latency for the support flow and predictable monthly spend.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Schedule a demo + technical deep dive (30-45m) with our SRE/SEs so we can show architecture and quantization options.
2) Loop in your security and procurement folks so we can cover SOC2, data flows, and procurement timeline.

I have the following slots next week (PT):
- Tue 8/24: 10:00-11:00 or 2:00-3:00
- Thu 8/26: 9:00-10:00 or 11:00-12:00

Can you confirm which works and whom I should loop in on your side? I attached my quick discovery notes for reference and a draft mutual action plan.

Attachments: finpath-discovery-notes.pdf

Thanks,

marissa@redwood.com | (415) 555-0132
